title: Babylon: Myth and Reality — Teachers’ Resource
lineage: British Museum dates Ashurbanipal’s reign 668–631 BCE and describes a royal collection at Nineveh. Approximately 25,000 tablets is a retrospective estimate, not a contemporary inventory; later Museum sources count fragments differently.
